item.title: Confidence Intervals (Part 3)
item.description:
#### Confidence Intervals with Paired Data :

Sometimes an experiment is designed in such a way that each item in one sample is paired with an item in the other. Let \(D_1, D-2, ..., D_n\) be a small random sample \((n \leq 30)\) of differences of the paired data.
